apps.review_notes: Tap the optional Apple Health sleep button and inspect the permission explanation, denial/no-data fallback, and generated alibi if samples exist. Also verify the manual estimate, generate, and reset paths. No data is written to Apple Health.
apps.privacy_boundary: Optional read-only Apple Health sleep samples are processed on-device and not collected; manual estimate and alibi stay on-device; no account, analytics, ads, or network.

apps.name: Unnecessary: Health Horoscope

apps.name: Unnecessary: Hydration Narc
apps.subtitle: A bottle with opinions
apps.promotional_text: Log your water. Receive one passive-aggressive report from the bottle.
apps.description: Define what one serving means to you, choose a daily target, and log water with one tap. Hydration Narc keeps today’s bottle report, lets you undo accidents, and shows a seven-day history with exactly the amount of attitude requested. Your target is your choice, not a medical recommendation.
apps.review_notes: Choose a personal serving goal, log two servings, undo one, and log again. Relaunch to verify same-day persistence. The app automatically rolls a completed day into its seven-day local ledger. Empty today’s ledger requires confirmation and preserves earlier summaries. Optional read-only Apple Health water import and one optional local daily nudge are available; manual logging works without either.
apps.privacy_boundary: Manual serving count, personal goal, bottle report, and seven-day summaries stay on-device. Optional read-only Apple Health water entries are processed on-device for comparison and are not collected or transmitted. Optional local daily nudge notifications are generic and stay on-device. No account, analytics, ads, cloud sync, or network.
